scripts: UPDATE stock SET S_QUANTITY = S_QUANTITY - 1, S_YTD = S_YTD + 1, S_ORDER_CNT = S_ORDER_CNT + 1 WHERE S_W_ID = 1 AND S_I_ID = 35031

success_criteria: Concurrent txns block on the same stock row and produce measurable row-lock waits.
The injection window stays within the 15 second observation window.
hot_update_stock_1.risk_assessment: Medium-high: intentionally serializes updates on a hot TPC-C stock row and can elevate latency, but the task is bounded to the observation window.
